description: Padding the full source tensor to the local output shape can fail before slicing is reached.
trigger: Load a full 512-by-64 weight into a Linear requesting 130 outputs and 64 inputs, with full_out_features=512, first_out_feature=0 and the default pad_to=128.
expected_behavior: Select the requested output region and pad the local result to 256 outputs.
actual_behavior: pad_out first allocates a 256-by-64 tensor and attempts to assign the full 512-by-64 source into it. The incompatible assignment precedes LinearFP16's slicing.

verification.description: Whole-parent search locates Linear.load as the direct caller of load_fp16; it tries FP16 after EXL3 lookup fails. The observation concerns the newly parameterized ordinary weight branch.
verification.limits: No existing model construction requesting this new slice was demonstrated.

verification.description: Computed the padded destination width as 256 and verified that the 512-row source exceeds it.
verification.limits: Shape arithmetic only; the PyTorch assignment and its exception were not executed.

finding.description: Inherited padding-before-slicing can prevent loading the final gated-MLP slice.
finding.trigger: Convert an ordinary unsplit checkpoint with intermediate_size=55,297 and aligned hidden size, using the default split threshold and pad_to=128.
finding.expected_behavior: Select the final 27,649 output features, then pad the selected gate/up weight to 27,776 outputs.
finding.actual_behavior: Linear.load_fp16 calls pad_out on the complete 55,297-row source first, attempting to assign it to a 27,776-row destination before LinearFP16 can slice.
